title: Description frame and adjective bank
subject: Arabic
source: Written for arabic/y9 lesson 13 (Description frame and adjective bank (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 13: Bridge: what does he look like? Describing people. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

model.title: Describe my uncle in three sentences.

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: My uncle is tall. He has brown hair and a short beard. He is generous and patient.
Features with لَهَا: لَهَا شَعْرٌ. Colour then length: أَسْوَدُ طَوِيلٌ (شَعْر is masculine). Character, feminine: وَهِيَ صَبُورَةٌ.

questions.q: Describe a woman with long black hair who is patient.
questions.a: لَهَا شَعْرٌ أَسْوَدُ طَوِيلٌ، وَهِيَ صَبُورَةٌ.

questions.q: Core: Describe a real or imagined person you admire in four sentences: height, hair, eyes, character (portal response box).
questions.a: For example: جَدِّي قَصِيرٌ. لَهُ شَعْرٌ أَبْيَضُ. لَهُ عَيْنَانِ بُنِّيَّتَانِ. هُوَ كَرِيمٌ وَلَطِيفٌ.

questions.q: Extend: Rewrite your description for a female (or male) person, changing every agreement.
questions.a: Correct ة endings and لَهَا / هِيَ throughout

questions.q: Stretch: Join two ideas with لٰكِنَّ + pronoun: لٰكِنَّهُ / لٰكِنَّهَا.
questions.a: For example: هِيَ قَصِيرَةٌ لٰكِنَّهَا قَوِيَّةٌ.
B) هِيَ طَوِيلَةٌ وَلَطِيفَةٌ. Both adjectives agree with هِيَ: ـَة.

questions.q: 'He has' (for features) is: A) لَهُ B) لَهَا C) عِنْدِي
Big question: describe someone kindly in one Arabic sentence.
